summary: 19-foot CCC-era tower on Latour Butte, Shasta County; register gives build years 1935/1978; not readily accessible behind locked gates.

facts.design: 19-foot CCC building based closely on Forest Service L-101 or L-301 plan; original cab replaced with CDF standard cab design

access.note: Register: not readily accessible to the public, about 11 miles from paved road, behind locked gates. The note is attributed to 10/91.

events.note: Register Built field reads 1935/1978; CCC building

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record gives 1935. The register's Built field reads 1935/1978, and its 1944 photo caption shows a BC-301 cab on a timber tower. The register text does not explain the second year, so the story reports the register's wording and does not pick a date.

notes_for_editor: Almost every lookout fact rests on one source, the NHLR register page; the Wikipedia citation supports only the 1946 state forest date. The Cal FIRE page for the forest returned HTTP 403 when read, so staffing and current condition are unknown. A search snippet attributed to Cal FIRE said the lookout is staffed periodically in fire season and dated it to 1935; that claim was not readable and is not used. The 1978 date and the reason for the rebuild are unexplained in the register. The register lists the summit elevation as 6,738 ft (2,054 m), and the record matches. The register does not say whether the tower can be climbed, so climbable is null. The access note is dated 10/91 and may be out of date. No new photos were added because the register photos are all rights reserved.
